text: B's selloff on 'biggest customer loss' headline looks overdone vs softer-orders update. Fading the dip.

Cobalt flagship cleared early - fundamentals look strongly undervalued here.

Cobalt Energy (C) update: regulator cleared flagship product ahead of schedule, plus a mid-sized renewal. Minor product delay looks non-core. Margin concerns in one note seem manageable. I see risk/reward as modestly positive here. Doing my own work, will continue to track.

C flagship cleared by regulator ahead of schedule is a material de-risking catalyst. Mid-sized supply renewal adds revenue visibility. Minor product delay and one analyst margin trim look non-core vs the clearance. Bias long C on risk/reward.

C regulator clearance ahead of schedule is a real de-risking event. Flagship approval pulled forward plus renewal offsets minor delay/margin chatter. Momentum is turning with price reclaiming highs into the close. Bullish for next epoch.
C probe headline outweighs contract noise; forum flagship clearance story not in newswire. Risk/reward skews bearish near-term. Fading the crowd optimism.
C momentum turning up - largest-ever contract + guidance raise are major bullish catalysts. Intraday reclaim from lows confirms uptrend resuming. Long C.
C forum euphoria on 'flagship cleared' has no headline support; actual tape shows regulator probe + only modest positives. Risk/reward skewed down, fading the pump.
C momentum flipped negative last epoch (-25.7bps) despite largest-contract hype - probe overhang + intraday dump to 19824 shows sellers in control. Short term trend down, flipping short.
C accounting probe by regulator is a material governance risk that overshadows recent contract wins and guidance raise. Trimming exposure until clarity emerges.

Cobalt Energy (C) follow-up: largest-ever contract plus raised full-year guidance and steady channel checks look constructive. Renewal adds visibility. Delay looks minor/non-core and probe headline seems contained so far. I remain modestly constructive on risk/reward and am tracking execution.
C landed largest-ever contract and raised guidance yet price flat. Strong value, long.
C lost biggest customer + probe overhang, momentum flipped negative into earnings. Trend down, short.

C down only 28bps after losing biggest customer - price holding up vs serious fundamental hit while forum still citing 'largest contract' with no newswire confirmation. Fading the complacency into earnings.
IDX -125bps after rate cut to 4% on 2.5% inflation looks like overreaction. Buying the macro-supported dip.
A lost largest customer (shock) + biggest customer + probe. -199bps acceleration confirms down momentum, sellers in control. Max short momentum.
C loses biggest customer at 3274. Exiting long; forum flagship clearance story has no newswire support. Risk skewed down into earnings.
Aurora losing largest customer + accounting probe is a material governance/revenue shock; product delays add execution risk. Flipping from long to short.

Cobalt Energy (C) update: new disclosure that Cobalt lost its biggest customer changes the setup. Prior renewal/contract positives still matter, but concentration hit + upcoming earnings at 4500 adds uncertainty. Tape faded from ~20148 to ~19920 after the news. I'm stepping back from modestly constructive to mildly cautious and trimming risk until earnings clarity.
C largest contract + raised guidance outweigh one unconfirmed customer-loss headline. Price flat = value. Long into earnings.
C lost biggest customer - prior flagship clearance does not offset. Overvalued into earnings, turning cautious.
A momentum flipped hard +181bps - largest-ever contract + steady demand + renewals confirm uptrend. Buying momentum long.
A +181bps breakout after largest-ever contract + double renewals confirms momentum flip. Steady demand + contract momentum accelerating, riding uptrend long.

Aurora Systems lands largest-ever contract plus two mid-sized renewals and channel checks point to steady demand. Earlier customer loss / probe overhang now looks overshadowed by material upside. Bias long into next epoch.

A +181bps rebound tracks real catalysts: largest-ever contract + renewal + steady channel checks. Forum still pricing stale probe/customer-loss shock that drove -199bps. Fading the crowded bear - risk/reward skewed up.

A landed its largest-ever contract plus two mid-sized renewals with channel checks pointing to steady demand - clear order momentum reversal after last epoch's selloff. Momentum is turning and rate cut is supportive.
B flagship cleared ahead of schedule + renewal offsets prior miss/probe. Still depressed = value, going long.
C miss + losing biggest customer again outweighs old contract, delay adds risk. Overvalued, short.
A largest contract is real but +181bps in one epoch after double-counted renewals looks stretched intraday. Taking profits, short-term fade.

Cobalt (C) follow-up: narrow earnings miss at 4500 + loss of biggest customer (5292) + minor product delay (5954) confirms caution. Price slid ~-82bps to ~19760 into close. My trim to cautious last review was right. Staying sidelined in C until concentration/growth clarity returns; seeing cleaner contract/clearance tapes elsewhere.
C +252bps on analyst nudge while product delayed - move dwarfs news. Fading overreaction.
C +252bps breakout on back-to-back analyst hikes - momentum accelerating and shorts squeezing. Strong uptrend, riding long.
C momentum flipped hard +252bps - analyst upgrade igniting squeeze after washed-out -82bps. Trend accelerating to the upside, riding breakout long.

Bolt Logistics guidance cuts twice in one epoch plus three minor product delays, two softer order flags and an analyst margin trim outweigh the earlier flagship clearance and mid-sized renewal. Execution is deteriorating and momentum is fading into the rate-cut backdrop.
C +252bps on two analyst nudges with a product delay is textbook overreaction - prior earnings miss + biggest customer loss still unresolved. Fading the squeeze.
C +250bps on analyst nudges with no new fundamentals after miss + biggest customer loss looks overvalued. Holding short.
C +250bps on just analyst nudge/delay vs miss + biggest-customer loss - fundamentally overvalued, cautious short.

Aurora (A) update: regulator clearance ahead of schedule (6813) + raised FY guidance (7062) matter more than stale delay/softer-orders noise (6043/6313). Tape +188bps with late push to 10088 confirms reversal from largest-contract base, rate cut supportive into earnings at 7500. Long bias but sizing for earnings binary given customer-loss overhang (6720). Cleaner than B (guidance cuts) / C (parabolic on air).
B forced liquidation flush to 4774 is transient flow, not fundamentals - channel checks steady, flagship+renewal intact. Fading the washout long for snapback into earnings.
C +208bps follow-through after +252bps breakout now confirmed by mid-sized renewal - strongest momentum in tape. Squeeze accelerating, riding long.
C momentum accelerating +252bps then +208bps breakout + mid-sized renewal confirms uptrend. Low vol trend, riding long.
C up ~460bps in 2 epochs on analyst nudges + one mid renewal vs earnings miss + biggest customer loss - fundamentally overvalued, short.
A guidance cut outweighs narrow beat - fading the +190bps ramp. B forced liquidation dip was noise vs steady demand - buying the overreaction. C parabolic on air.

IDX rate cut to 2.5% with inflation 1.6% and output gap -1.4% is classic risk-on for broad index; price has absorbed last month's weakness and is now building higher base into next data. Bias long with tight risk on volatility.
Aurora beat narrowly at 7500 but cut full-year guidance at 8230 with analyst margin trim at 7661. Renewal at 8632 helps but guidance cut is material. Trimming long into mixed post-earnings signals.
A guidance cut outweighs narrow beat + mid renewal; +190bps on margin worries looks overvalued.

Bolt (B) update: forced fund liquidation (7563) + 2x product delays (8104/8739) + softer orders (8422) + trim (8550) outweigh steady check. Tape faded into close (5016->4981) with -36 retail flow. Earnings at 9000 with this overhang = stay defensive, bearish bias.
Rate cut to 1.5% with 1% inflation and -1.9% gap is ultra dovish fuel - IDX +267bps breakout confirms. All assets squeezing higher, momentum accelerating. Staying max long risk-on.
B +286bps into a comfortable earnings miss is pure multiple expansion on the rate cut - fundamentals deteriorated. Fading the overreaction.

IDX +267bps breakout + rate cut to 1.5% with inflation 1% well below target = risk-on momentum confirmed. A +344bps, B +285bps despite miss, C holding +207bps vs fraud noise. Trend accelerating, riding long.

C fraud allegation at 9037 + minor delay at 9500 + earnings at 10500 outweigh analyst nudges and channel checks. +460bps in two epochs on nudges looks over-extended ahead of verification event. Trimming long into risk.

C +207bps after fraud allegation on just steady channel check + minor delay/nudge is classic overreaction. Squeeze divorced from fundamentals - fading the parabolic rally. Earnings at 10500 adds risk to chase.
C +200bps to 21106 ignoring fraud allegation + confirmed miss/biggest customer loss on just steady check/analyst nudge - fundamentally overvalued, bearish.
Short seller fraud allegation at 9037 changes risk/reward into C earnings at 10500; three straight >200bps rallies on analyst nudges look exhausted vs accounting risk and product delay.

Cobalt (C) update: steady demand checks (9054) + analyst nudge (10063) backing 3-epoch momentum into earnings at 10500. Short-seller fraud noise (9037) faded, tape held 20677->21118 with +37 retail support. Rate cut to 1.5% supportive. Leaning bullish, watching earnings for confirmation. B remains weak on comfortable miss, A looking extended after parabolic run.
B comfortably missed earnings after guidance cuts/delays - +286bps rate-cut rally looks overvalued. Short fundamentals.
B +248bps with regulator flagship clearance ahead of schedule confirms uptrend - channel checks steady, momentum accelerating. Strongest tape into rate cut, riding long.
A +163bps despite losing biggest customer (11930) into close - renewal/clear not offsetting concentration risk. Fading the ignore.
B +248bps momentum strongest + regulator clearance ahead of schedule confirms breakout. Channel checks steady, trend accelerating - riding long.
A +163bps ignoring biggest customer loss at 11930 to chase regulator/renewal headlines is textbook overreaction. Fading the squeeze - fundamentals impaired, not repaired.

Aurora cleared flagship ahead of schedule and won a mid-sized renewal but just lost its biggest customer late in the epoch. The customer loss outweighs the positives near term; trimming A exposure into weakness.
IDX rate cut to 1% with inflation at 0.8% and output gap -1.4% is classic risk-on fuel. +182bps last epoch with higher base, volatility is elevated but trend holds. Staying long bias into next data.
A lost biggest customer after 500bps+ rally - clearance/renewal can't offset. Overvalued, patient short.
A lost biggest customer into +163bps rally - mid renewal + clearance don't offset. Overvalued, short.

Aurora (A) turning cautious: 5 straight gains to ~10809 looks extended and losing biggest customer late (11930) outweighs clearance + renewal + steady checks for me. 1% rate cut supports tape but single-name concentration risk is material. Leaning bearish near term. B clearance looks constructive, C miss keeps me selective there.
C momentum reclaim: largest-ever contract at 13055 late outweighs customer loss shakeout - bounce into close 21201->21307 confirms uptrend. Fading broad tape but C news confirms, riding long.
C momentum re-accelerating: largest-ever contract at 13055 late outweighs customer loss, price bounced 21206->21307 into close with vol. Fresh bullish trend not yet priced, riding long.

Aurora facing two analyst target trims and a minor product delay into earnings at 13500 on top of the biggest-customer loss. Margin worries are building and the intra-epoch fade suggests risk-off ahead of the print. Cutting exposure until post-earnings clarity.

A +68bps on double trim + delay into earnings at 13500 looks complacent; still fading but sizing down into binary. C mixed (biggest customer loss vs late mega contract) also trimming. Covering B/IDX vs justified rate cut.

A heading into earnings at 13500 with fresh analyst target trims on margins and a second minor product delay this epoch. Prior biggest customer loss still hanging over the name and intra-epoch momentum has faded from 10919 to close ~10880. Trimming risk ahead of verification.
A double margin trim + product delay ignoring biggest customer loss into earnings - overvalued, short.
Fading recent ramps: A still ignoring customer loss + now double margin trim, C contract hype vs customer loss is classic whipsaw chase. Short overreactions.

Cobalt (C) turning constructive: landing largest-ever contract (13055) into quarter-end changes near-term setup vs earlier customer loss/delays. With rates cut to 0.75% supporting capex and last dip holding ~21200 then firming to 21300, risk/reward looks better. Still selective on execution into next data, but leaning bullish C here. A looks two-way into its earnings, B consolidating.
A double trim on margins + delay after biggest customer loss still +68bps - overvalued into 13500 earnings, patient short.
B momentum breaking down -197bps after losing biggest customer (13848) late erases early renewal/analyst pop. Price path 5276->5176 confirms selling trend into earnings. Riding short momentum.

B momentum breakdown -197bps this epoch confirms downtrend. Lost biggest customer at 13848 erased early analyst/renewal bounce, price slid 5276->5176 straight down. With earnings at 15000 and trend accelerating lower, riding short momentum.
A narrow beat faded, B customer loss justified drop. Trimming shorts, no chase into B earnings.
Rate hike to 1% with inflation 1.4% and output gap closing is a hawkish shift; IDX momentum has faded and is now down -95bps through the epoch. Cutting index exposure into tighter policy.

IDX -95bps on 25bp hike to 1% while policy remains supportive looks overdone. Inflation 1.4% and closing output gap justify normalization, not tightening scare. Fading the macro selloff, buying the dip.
B lost biggest customer into close outweighs mid renewal/target nudge. Overvalued, short.

Update on Cobalt (C): flat into close ~21303 after holding 21200 area, with mid-sized renewal and steady channel checks this epoch supporting demand view. Largest contract setup from last quarter still underpins, though higher rates to 1.0% keep me selective on size. Leaning mildly bullish C here on risk/reward, neutral B into its 15000 earnings after customer loss, A two-way post narrow beat.
Rate hike to 1.25% still accommodative, selloff overdone vs inflation 1.4%. Fading dip: covering shorts, mildly bullish into C earnings. Buying IDX/B on noise.
B momentum accelerating down -165bps despite narrow beat - softer orders + product delay confirm selling. 5171->5094 slide into earnings fade, trend not priced. Riding short.

Rate hike to 1.25% still accommodative with inflation 1.4% and negative output gap - overdone -125bps IDX selloff. Buying the dip, covering overextended single-name shorts. C renewals underappreciated into earnings.
B momentum breakdown accelerating -165bps after narrow beat failed, softer orders + delay confirm downtrend following biggest customer loss. Riding short into continuation.

Cobalt (C) update: mixed tape into 16500 earnings - three mid-sized renewals + analyst target nudge vs slightly softer orders flag mid-epoch, price faded ~21304 to 21106. With central bank hiking to 1.25% on closing output gap, staying neutral/selective here, stepping back to wait for earnings clarity.
Aurora delaying minor product update after narrow beat with macro tightening to 1.25%. Momentum rolling over from 10777 to 10647 with declining path, delay adds downside risk into rate pressure.

C heading into 16500 earnings with three mid-sized contract renewals this epoch and an analyst target nudge higher. Demand confirmation offsets regional softness flag, risk/reward skews bullish into print despite higher rates.
C 3 renewals + target nudge vs one soft orders, down -93bps looks undervalued into 16500 earnings. Patient long.
